title: A read-only Kimi reviewer child is refused the read-only Engram MCP words (show), so it reviews without the item's acceptance criteria; Claude read-only children are not
outcome: A read-only (writePolicy readOnly) Kimi delegation child can call the read-only Engram MCP words (show, ls, memories, search), as a read-only Claude child already can. Write words stay refused, and the CLI route stays refused as it is today. A test covers a Kimi read-only child: show succeeds and a write word is refused.
acceptance: A read-only Kimi reviewer child is refused the read-only Engram MCP words (show), so it reviews without the item's acceptance criteria; Claude read-only children are not is done
